hook: IF YOU CAN'T BE YOURSELF|IT'S OKAY|TO STEP BACK

voices.name: l00
voices.text: A good relationship <#0.2#> is one where you can fully be yourself.
voices.caption: A good relationship is one where you can fully be yourself.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Lightly, like breathing, <#0.2#> shining just by being.
voices.caption: Lightly, like breathing, shining just by being.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Go deep with the people <#0.2#> who love that you.
voices.caption: Go deep with the people who love that you.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: But if a relationship keeps you <#0.2#> from being yourself,
voices.caption: But if a relationship keeps you from being yourself,

voices.name: l05
voices.text: You don't need permission. <#0.2#> You don't need approval.
voices.caption: You don't need permission. You don't need approval.
